text: dsh-tab-plan-toggle 是一个面向 DeepSeek Harness 网页客户端的界面插件，在消息输入框中按 Tab 即可切换计划模式。插件把一个隐藏标记注册到对话输入区，检测当前焦点是否位于编辑器，并通过 Harness 的 Plan 命令开启或关闭模式；当命令菜单打开、组合键或输入法组合期间会让 Tab 保持原有用途。它根据会话计划状态决定切换方向，适合希望用键盘快速进入或退出计划模式的网页用户。需要 DeepSeek Harness 0.2.0-rc.2 或更新版本及 Web UI；代码未声明 API 密钥或外部服务。

dsh-tab-plan-toggle adds a Tab shortcut to switch plan mode in the DeepSeek Harness web composer. It checks editor focus and session state before running the on/off command; menus and modified keys are left alone. Requires Harness 0.2.0-rc.2+ and Web UI. No API key or external service is declared.
想在网页聊天输入框里用快捷键打开或关闭计划模式。
让 DSH 在输入框聚焦时按 Tab 就能切换 Plan。
Can I use a keyboard shortcut to switch plan mode while typing in the web composer?
dsh-tab-plan-toggle 的功能「Tab 切换计划模式」：在网页对话输入框聚焦时按 Tab，根据当前会话计划状态执行开启或关闭命令。若焦点不在编辑器、快捷键带修饰键、正在输入法组合或菜单打开，则不拦截 Tab。

dsh-tab-plan-toggle README · Tab Plan Toggle：**Press Tab to turn Plan mode on and off, right from the message box.**

No typing `/plan`. No hunting through menus. Just tap Tab while you're typing.

---

dsh-tab-plan-toggle README · What it does：| You do this | What happens |
| --- | --- |
| Press `Tab` in the message box | Plan mode turns **on** |
| Press `Tab` again | Plan mode turns **off** |

A blue **Plan** badge appears in the message box whenever Plan mode is on, and the hint text changes to *"describe your task to generate plan"* — so you always know where you stand.

dsh-tab-plan-toggle README · What it does：Tab behaves normally everywhere else. It only toggles Plan mode when your cursor is in the message box, so it never gets in your way while you're writing code, reading, or moving around the app.

---

dsh-tab-plan-toggle README · Install：Open a terminal and run:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:sujalmandal/dsh-tab-plan-toggle
```

Then restart DeepSeek Harness:

```bash
dsh web
```

That's it. Open the app and try pressing `Tab` while typing a message.

---

dsh-tab-plan-toggle README · Everyday questions：**I pressed Tab and nothing happened.**
Make sure your cursor is actually *in the message box* — click into it first. Tab does nothing if you're focused somewhere else, which is on purpose.

**The `/` command menu is open and Tab isn't toggling.**
That's intended. Inside the `/` and `@` menus, Tab moves between menu items, exactly as it always has.

**Does it work in every conversation?**
Yes. It works in new chats and in conversations you already have open.

dsh-tab-plan-toggle README · Everyday questions：**Will it survive DeepSeek Harness updates?**
Yes — and this is the main thing the current version fixes. Earlier versions reached into the app's internals, so a Harness update could quietly break them. This version only uses the same public, supported controls the app itself uses to toggle Plan mode. It has nothing private left to break.

---

dsh-tab-plan-toggle README · Updating：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:sujalmandal/dsh-tab-plan-toggle
```

Run the same command as installing. It fetches the newest version and replaces the old one.

---

dsh-tab-plan-toggle README · Uninstalling：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-tab-plan-toggle
```

Then restart `dsh web`. Tab goes straight back to its normal behaviour.

---

dsh-tab-plan-toggle README · Requirements：- DeepSeek Harness `0.2.0-rc.2` or newer
- The web UI (`dsh web`)

---

dsh-tab-plan-toggle README · For the curious：<details>
<summary>How it works under the hood</summary>

This is a small client-side plugin. It watches for Tab inside the composer, then runs DeepSeek Harness's own `/plan` and `/plan off` commands — the exact same ones you'd type by hand.

It installs straight from the GitHub repository rather than the npm registry, since it isn't published there — the install command above already points at the right place.

dsh-tab-plan-toggle README · For the curious：Because it goes through the app's public command interface and its public plan-mode state, it reads the real value the app uses to decide whether Plan mode is on. That means the badge, the button, and this plugin always agree — there's no separate copy of the state that can drift.

It uses **no host-side code and no private APIs**, which is what makes it durable across updates.

</details>
